goal: Parallel Native Metal compute pipeline for every ordinary registered formula; correct reuse; measured whole-render acceleration
phase_order: 77 ordinary M3Parameter scenes in current queue order
remaining ordinary formula fixtures and hybrid/parameter stress cases

policies.precision: native GPU FP32; retain CPU native/compatible and separate compatible Metal
policies.cpu_role: file IO, command submission, bounded metadata/resource preparation and validation; no fractal pixel evaluation in a reported Metal render
policies.ordered_dependencies: Allowed only with documented dependency proof and adversarial GPU tests; no unknown classification counts as done
policies.reuse: Exact input identity plus required incoming state; replay state outputs and logical work, separate physical-work counters; no approximate spatial reuse
policies.speed_gate: geometric-mean full-render warm speedup >=1.25 over pinned baseline on matched completed cases; no >5% reproducible full-render regression; report cold separately
policies.repeat_gate: 3 exact RGB and deterministic logical/work/cache-record repeats under the same declared cache state
policies.holdout: separate generated perturbations, state-poisoning cases, mixed chains, cache invalidation and concurrent renders; not used to choose optimizations

whole_frame_fp32_fallback.requires: Recorded proof of genuine binary32 overflow, original resources/settings/effects, successful complete Native CPU frame and three exact repeats on final identity. Classification alone is insufficient.
whole_frame_fp32_fallback.reported_as: QUALIFIED_FP32_CPU; never GPU or parity PASS

obligations: source-bound read/write and initialization analysis for all 467 formulas and their drivers
GPU scheduling proof per independent unit; preserve necessary recurrence and dependent bounces
bounded GPU resource/pipeline/result reuse with key invalidation and lifetime tests

all 77 original-size full scenes with active effects on GPU, or qualified whole-frame Native CPU fallback for proven genuine FP32 overflow only; <=300 seconds each; deferred scenes remain OPEN until speedup demonstrated
device formula fixtures for every registry identity plus mixed chains and state transitions
measured baseline/candidate full-render speed and compilation latency
independent held-out verification, ordinary CPU and compatible Metal regression, negative guards

predicate.runner_status: ROUND0_PARTIAL_SELF_TESTED; full proof adapters OPEN_VALIDATOR after independent critique; not acceptance-ready

completion_caveat: Thresholded measurable acceleration is not a claim of a mathematical global maximum; stop conditions also include plateau or 50-cycle ceiling with explicit OPEN results.

amendment.authority: Explicit user approval: real FP32 overflow may render the whole frame on Native CPU; continue autonomously.
